pr.title: Add Foundry Toolbox resource and deploy pipeline
pr.author: davidfowl

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension unit tests (Windows) / Run VS Code extension unit tests (Windows)
failed_jobs.reason: Windows unit test job fails to produce extension/out/aspire-extension.vsix ('No files were found with the provided path'), causing Install dependencies/Package VSIX/Assert steps to fail with generic exit code 1. Job logs unavailable. Matches known recurring infra pattern vscode-extension-vsix-package-build-failure (issue #19745). PR only changes Aspire.Hosting.Foundry, unrelated to VS Code extension packaging.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, discovery-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: E2E job fails at 'Download VSIX' step: 'Artifact not found for name: aspire-extension' — a cascading failure from the upstream Windows unit test/VSIX packaging job which never uploaded the artifact. Matches known recurring infra pattern vscode-extension-e2e-vsix-artifact-not-found (issue #19744). PR only changes Aspire.Hosting.Foundry, unrelated to the VS Code extension.
